versions.subject: rule: download using certreq
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\certreq.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -Post '
        - ' -config '
        - ' http'
        - ' C:\windows\win.ini '
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\certreq.exe" CommandLine="* -Post *" CommandLine="* -config *" CommandLine="* http*" CommandLine="* C:\\windows\\win.ini *"

versions.subject: Merge PR #5727 from @RiqTam - Fix rule to detect downloads via CertReq
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\certreq.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'CertReq.exe'
selection_cli_flag_post:
    CommandLine|contains|windash: '-Post'
selection_cli_flag_config:
    CommandLine|contains|windash: '-config'
selection_cli_http:
    CommandLine|contains: 'http'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\certreq.exe" OR OriginalFileName="CertReq.exe" CommandLine="*-Post*" OR CommandLine="*/Post*" OR CommandLine="*–Post*" OR CommandLine="*—Post*" OR CommandLine="*―Post*" CommandLine="*-config*" OR CommandLine="*/config*" OR CommandLine="*–config*" OR CommandLine="*—config*" OR CommandLine="*―config*" CommandLine="*http*"
